title: Renew a motor vehicle recycler licence
summary: This page explains how to renew your motor vehicle recycler licence online.
intro:
You'll receive a renewal notice for your motor vehicle recycler licence a month before the expiry date. You can then apply online to renew your licence before it expires.

You can apply for a 1, 3 or 5-year licence.

To find your motor vehicle recycler licence number and details, visit Verify NSW.
what_you_need: Your renewal number (as shown on your renewal notice), or your full personal details

how_to_steps.text: Follow the prompts to renew your licence.

faqs.q: How far in advance do I receive notice of my licence renewal?
faqs.a: You will receive a renewal notice for your motor vehicle recycler licence one month before the expiry date.

faqs.q: What licence terms can I apply for?
faqs.a: You can apply for a 1, 3, or 5-year licence.

faqs.q: What should I do if I miss the renewal deadline?
faqs.a: If your licence expired less than 3 months ago, you may apply to restore it at a Service NSW Centre. If it has expired more than 3 months, you must apply for a new licence to be re-issued.
